mixers.note: 32 heads of 128; short conv kernel 4 on q, k, v; low-rank sigmoid output gate
32 heads, latent KV 512, no query latent; NoPE

position.nope_layers: all; KDA layers carry order in their recurrence, MLA layers set mla_use_nope

moe.router: sigmoid scores, aux-loss-free bias (e_score_correction_bias), top-8, renormalised; routed_scaling_factor 2.446

stack.note: 1-based config lists: MLA at 4, 8, ... 24 and 27; KDA elsewhere

steps.label: KDA: conv on q, k, v; fine-grained decay; RMSNorm then low-rank sigmoid gate on output
1 shared + top-8 of 256 experts of width 1024 (layer 1: dense SwiGLU 9216)

notes: Config head_dim 72 equals d_model / heads; neither mixer uses it (KDA heads are 128, MLA q/k heads 128 + 64).
Config has no max_position_embeddings; context value comes from model_max_length 1,048,576.
Config keeps qk_rope_head_dim 64 while setting mla_use_nope; the paper says all MLA layers use NoPE.
Parent is Kimi K2 (MLA + fine-grained MoE recipe at small scale); the paper compares against a full-MLA baseline.
README describes the layout as 3:1 KDA to MLA; the config gives 20 KDA and 7 MLA layers, the last group being 2:1.
